methods.scope: Six released CSVs only. No classifier training, raw-export matching, calibration, or physical product inspection is performed by this script.
methods.schema: UTF-8 CSV, one header row, ordered data1..data200,label; finite numeric signal values and label 0/1 are required. Failure stops before results are written.
methods.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q; min, 5th, 25th, 50th, 75th, 95th, max percentiles. These describe the retained records, not sampling uncertainty.
methods.peak: Largest stored value. Peak index is the first index attaining that value, with indices 1..200.
methods.zero_boundaries: Exact numeric zero. First/last nonzero indices are 1-based; null for an all-zero row. All-zero rows have 200 leading and 200 trailing zeros by convention and zero interior zeros.
methods.shape: Mean-to-peak ratio = sum(x)/(200*max(x)); half-peak count = number of points x>=0.5*max(x). They are descriptive index-domain features, not energy, work or duration. Null if peak<=0.
methods.rms: sqrt(sum(x*x)/200), on native export scale; no physical calibration inferred.
methods.peak_ties: Count exact occurrences of the row maximum and longest consecutive run at that maximum. Quantization or plateau evidence alone cannot establish instrument saturation.
methods.duplicates: Exact equality of complete 200-value Python float tuples; labels are excluded from waveform identity.
methods.canonical_hash: Concatenate each row as 200 little-endian float64 values with signed zero normalized, followed by one unsigned label byte. This hash scheme differs from earlier textual canonical hashes.
methods.pointwise_summary: The optional companion CSV contains the label-0 pointwise median and 5th/95th percentiles, without smoothing, alignment, resampling or normalization.

saturation_assessment.reason: ADC resolution, transfer function, full-scale and saturation flags are not supplied. Observed maxima and flat-top counts are descriptive and cannot demonstrate either saturation or its absence.
